meta.description: The free Kahoot alternative. Host interactive quizzes right from your browser.
meta.title: Home

index_page.get_ranking_and_winners: Get the ranking and see who won
index_page.no_tracking_content: frogQuiz doesn't track players or send anything to third parties.
index_page.self_hostable_content: frogQuiz runs on our own infrastructure, so quiz data stays with us.
index_page.user_friendly_content: frogQuiz aims to be simple enough that nobody needs training to run a quiz.
index_page.completely_free_content: frogQuiz is completely cost free (for the user), without any paid plans or annoying redirects to the upgrade-page. Donations are highly appreciated.
index_page.quiz_results_downloadable_content: Quiz results export straight to an Excel spreadsheet.
index_page.multilingual_content: frogQuiz is available in a range of languages, switchable from the footer.
index_page.dark_mode_content: Light and dark themes, following your system setting by default.
index_page.german_server_content: frogQuiz's servers are located in Germany and hosted by netcup.
index_page.download_quizzes_content: Quizzes download as a single file and can be re-imported at any time, including into another frogQuiz instance.
index_page.community_driven_content: frogQuiz depends on its community for funding, testing ideas, feature requests, translations and more! You can also be a part of the frogQuiz-community!
index_page.no_player_limit_content: frogQuiz doesn't impose an artificial player limit — it's been tested with up to 300 players in one quiz.
index_page.import_quiz_from_kahoot_and_edit: Import quizzes from Kahoot! and edit them in frogQuiz
index_page.join_prompt: Enter the PIN from the host’s screen.
